text:
maria: FYI — new candidate landed: Calypso-18B. model card here: https://models.redwood.example/calypso-18b
maria: Can we do a quick priority score for next-week bring-up? Use quick rubric: quality/latency/infra/safety (0-10). One line score + 1 short note please.
aj: 8 / 6 / 8 / 7 — quality looks noticeably better than current 13B baseline on summarization evals, latency a tad higher on long context, infra fit ok. recommend soft canary. :+1:
devin: 9 / 5 / 8 / 6 — strong QA / reasoning improvement in our small eval; worried about quantization sensitivity. suggest 4-bit smoke + mismatch checks.
lina: ran a tiny smoke on dev A10G (quick, not exhaustive):
```
setup: piper/dev-a10g-1
model: calypso-18b fp16 -> q4_0 (huggingface weights)
batch=8, seq=512
results:
  ppl: 12.8
  latency_cold: 180ms
  latency_warm: 45ms
  mem_peak: 17.6GB
  throughput: ~130 tok/s
```
-> baseline 13B fp16 warm latency ~38ms, so ~+7ms penalty, mem savings fine.

simon: 6 / 7 / 7 / 4 — quality fine generally but saw hallucination spike on doc-QA subset (2/8 failures, confounding citations). safety score low until we triage hallucination cases. recommend targeted eval set and prompt-safety tests.
aj: quick note: infra concern — model tokenization changes some punctuation; QA pipeline needs tiny adapter to normalize tokenizer differences.
eval-bot: eval-run finished: compare/summaries/full-suite v0.3 -> calypso-18b vs baseline: relative Rouge-L +4.1, F1+3.2, hallucination_rate +1.9% (investigate). link: https://evals.redwood.example/runs/5234
devin: proposal: P2 (high interest) but block canary until: (1) targeted doc-QA regression triage (2) q4 smoke shows <2% perf loss on main evals (3) safety review
maria: decision: Priority = P2 (proceed but guarded). Owner: @devin. Actions:
  - owner: @devin
  - eval set: @simon to add 50 focused doc-QA cases by EOD
  - quant plan: @lina to run q4_0/q4_1 + GPTQ compare by Tue
  - canary plan: short window, 1% traffic, monitoring hooks for hallucination and latency
  - infra prep: @aj to add tokenizer normalization adapter
  - safety: schedule 30m with trust & safety early next week
maria: if q4 smoke looks good and hallucination triage reduces failure rate <1%, we greenlight a 24h canary. otherwise hold.
aj: noted — will slot tokenizer change and smoke deploy in staging tomorrow morning.
simon: will hand over triage cases in a gist and add a quick repro for 2 failing queries.
lina: I'll post the q4_1/GPTQ runs once they finish (ETA ~10h). will include perf matrix (latency/throughput/mem) vs fp16.
maria: thanks team — short follow-ups only in this thread, major updates in PRD and onboarding ticket. :rocket:
